events.command: git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all && echo "--- ignored too ---" && git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all --ignored
ls -la && echo "--- build ---" && find build -type f | head -50 && echo "--- sizes ---" && du -sh build junk.log notes.tmp 2>/dev/null
ls -la && wc -c build/out.o build/cache/tmp.bin junk.log notes.tmp && echo "=== notes.tmp ===" && head -20 notes.tmp && echo "=== junk.log ===" && head -20 junk.log

set -e
TRASH="/tmp/repo-untracked-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
mkdir -p "$TRASH"
cd /tmp/agent-lab-mlvsohwa/repo
for p in build junk.log notes.tmp; do
  mv "$p" "$TRASH"/
done
echo "moved to: $TRASH"
find "$TRASH" | sort
git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all --ignored; echo "exit: clean tree check done"; git status --short --branch
